moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this weekend, with matches running from August 21-24, 2026, including Arsenal vs Coventry City and Newcastle United vs Liverpool.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League season kicks off today, bringing all the drama, goals, and glory we've been waiting for. Who are you backing for the title?

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Toppers
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the number one spot with 'Rein Me In' on the Official Singles Chart Top 40 for August 13-19, 2026, while Madonna & Kylie Minogue enter at number 8 with 'Love Sensation'.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are number one on the Official Singles Chart. Is 'Rein Me In' your anthem right now?

angles.name: Pop Legends Unite
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue together? Yes please! Their new track 'Love Sensation' has landed in the Top 10. What an iconic collab!

moments.title: Green Man Festival: No Burning of the Green Man
moments.blurb: Due to extremely dry conditions and high fire risk, the traditional burning of the Green Man effigy at the Green Man Festival (August 20-23, 2026) has been cancelled, with an alternative send-off planned.

angles.name: Green Man adapts
angles.copy: Big news from Green Man Festival! Due to fire risks, the iconic burning of the Green Man won't go ahead this year, but organisers promise an alternative, special send-off. Safety first!

angles.name: Festival Weather Watch
angles.copy: Heading to Green Man this weekend? Remember the fire ban is in place due to dry conditions. Stay safe, stay hydrated, and enjoy the incredible music!
